title: trackerHostWork
responsibility: Defines remote-work lease timing and the schemas that Tracker uses to validate claims and report work on the executing computer.

outputs.name: trackerHostWork
outputs.type: { leaseMs: number; renewMs: number; claim: Zod schema; report: Zod schema }
outputs.description: Sets a 150-second lease renewed every 30 seconds. A claim identifies the run, lease, host and SSH or Colima workload. A report lists up to 1,500 run and host pairs with their expiration times.
